items.title: `claude -p` のクラウドセッションで「Not logged in」エラーを修正
items.description: Fixed `claude -p` inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables

items.title: 多数のMCPツール使用時にAPIエラーが「prompt is too long」に上書きされる問題を修正
items.description: Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools
